outcomeDefinitions.incorporated: Explicitly cited in an active technology architecture artifact.

outcomeDefinitions.abstraction_guardrail: Retained as rationale or a warning against excess detail.

outcomeDefinitions.excluded: Explicitly outside the intended project scope.
